signals.text: Revenue grew 27% a year over 3 years vs 27% over 5: growth is steady.
Profit compounded at 28% vs revenue at 27%: profit is tracking sales.
Operating margin expanded 83 bps in 3 years (13.1% → 13.9%).
Working-capital days shortened by 28 days in 3 years (58 → 30).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 101% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

guidance.statement: Sustain medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13% under Project Spring.
guidance.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

guidance.statement: Grow the FMEG business at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
guidance.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.

guidance.statement: Over the medium- to long-term, sustainable margins for the EPC business are expected to remain in the high single-digit range.
guidance.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range

guidance.statement: The EHV plant is now expected to be commissioned in the next financial year, FY28.
guidance.quote: we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year in Q2 FY27.
Profit after tax reached a record high of INR 9,900 million, representing a 43% year-over-year increase.
EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4% in Q2 FY27.
Wires and Cables segment delivered 47% year-on-year revenue growth, with domestic growing 50% year-on-year.
FMEG segment registered a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27.
FMEG EBIT margins crossed double-digits for the first time, recording 10.1% during the quarter.

calls.tone: confident on demand and strategic execution, pleased with record-breaking performance and margin expansion

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned if 10.1% FMEG margin was driven solely by solar and if targets would be revised.
Scepticism regarding potential downside risks to growth and margins from new entrants like UltraTech.
Inquiring why wires outpaced cables despite macro demand drivers favoring cables.
Channel checks suggested competitors are pricing wires 10-15% lower; management denied seeing pricing corrections.

business.summary: Polycab manufactures and sells Wires and Cables, FMEG (Fast Moving Electrical Goods), and undertakes EPC projects, driving growth through distribution expansion and structural demand.

segments.name: Wires and Cables
segments.note: Primary segment, robust growth driven by domestic demand and infrastructure.

segments.name: FMEG
segments.note: Includes solar products, fans, lighting, switches, switchgear, conduits, and pipes.

segments.name: EPC
segments.note: Project execution including Bharat Net and RDSS.

guidance.statement: Maintain medium- to long-term Wires & Cables EBIT margin guidance of 11% to 13%.
guidance.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.

guidance.statement: Target FMEG EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.
guidance.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

guidance.statement: Target FMEG revenue growth at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth.
guidance.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.

guidance.statement: Expect overall growth at 1.5x of market growth, combining volume and value.
guidance.quote: I think we have always guided that we will do 1.5x of market growth, which is a mix of both volume and value.

guidance.statement: Expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.
guidance.quote: Over the medium to long term, we continue to expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.

guidance.statement: Export growth target of going north of 10% of overall top line by 2030.
guidance.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenues grew by 39% year-on-year.
EBITDA increased by 32% YoY with margins at 13.8%, improving 70 bps sequentially.
Achieved highest ever quarterly Profit After Tax of INR 7,967 million, up 33% YoY.
Wires & Cables segment registered a healthy 39% YoY growth.
FMEG segment delivered 71% YoY growth, marking the tenth consecutive quarter outperforming industry growth.
EPC business reported revenues of INR 3,077 million, down 11% YoY.

calls.tone: confident on domestic demand and strategic momentum, cautious on global geopolitical uncertainties and near-term volatility.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the increase in acceptances and payable days, and the accounting treatment of interest costs.
Scepticism regarding the 13% decline in exports and the heavy reliance on the Middle East.
Pressed on whether falling raw material prices led to suboptimal channel stocking and weak volume growth.
Concerned about lower volume growth over recent quarters and whether T&D/data centre demand could face delays.

guidance.statement: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years, which will further enhance our capabilities, scale and innovation.

guidance.statement: FMEG EBIT margins are aligned with Project Spring trajectory of achieving 8% to 10% EBITDA margins by FY30.
guidance.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter stood at 4.1%, in line with our Project Spring trajectory of achieving 8% to 10% EBITDA margins by financial year 2030.

guidance.statement: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.

guidance.statement: Annual sustainable operating margin for the EPC business is expected in the mid- to high single digits.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the mid- to high single digits over mid- to long term.

guidance.statement: Over long term expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin and in near to mid term 12% to 14%.
guidance.quote: and that a very calibrated guidance which we have given that over long term, we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin. and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
guidance.horizon: near to mid term / long term

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 27% year-on-year, driven by robust momentum in cables, wires, and FMEG segments.
Company delivered highest ever quarterly PAT of INR 7.9 billion, a growth of 7% year-on-year.
Volume growth for the quarter remained in the low single digits for cable and wire put together.
FMEG segment delivered 47% year-on-year growth, marking the ninth consecutive quarter of outperformance.
Capital expenditure for the quarter stood at INR 3.9 billion, taking full year capex to INR 14.8 billion.
Wires and Cables segment delivered a strong 30% year-on-year growth during the quarter.

calls.tone: confident on long-term demand and market share gains, acknowledging temporary headwinds from Middle East tensions

pushback.gist: Analysts asked about the severity of demand impact and volume slowdown during March due to Middle East disruptions.
Pressed on why volume growth was low single digit despite having surplus capacity and peers facing constraints.
Queried on whether price hikes in copper and PVC were fully passed on and if there were any inventory gains.

guidance.statement: Investing INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion annually through FY30 under Project Spring.
guidance.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.

guidance.statement: FMEG EBITDA margins expected in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30, positioning the business for sustained growth and value creation.

guidance.statement: FMEG segment targeted to achieve 1.5x to 2x industry growth by FY30.
guidance.quote: our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30

guidance.statement: EPC annual sustainable operating margin expected in high single digits over mid to long term.
guidance.quote: the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.

guidance.statement: Working capital cycle expected to normalize to long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days.
guidance.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.

guidance.statement: BharatNet scheme orders expected to generate INR 4.5 billion over next 3 years for execution.
guidance.quote: generate ₹ 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution and an additional ₹ 3.5 billion for 10 years for project O&M.

guidance.statement: Cables and wires long-term EBITDA margin guidance is 11% to 13%.
guidance.quote: to refer to our Project Spring guidance, we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%.

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenues grew 46% YoY driven by W&C and FMEG segments.
EBITDA margins stood at 12.7% or 13% excluding gratuity provisioning one-off of INR 219 million.
Delivered highest ever Q3 PAT at INR 6.3 billion, reflecting 36% YoY growth.
Domestic W&C business recorded 59% YoY revenue growth with nearly 40% volume growth.
FMEG segment delivered 17% YoY revenue growth in Q3 FY26.
EPC revenues grew 4% YoY reaching INR 4,069 million during the quarter.

calls.tone: Confident on strong demand and volume growth, but cautious on near-term margin pressures due to sharp commodity inflation.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned reasons for QoQ and YoY margin decline despite strong operating leverage and price hikes.
Analysts inquired about the softness in export growth and whether it was related to US tariffs.
Analysts pressed on whether high volume growth was driven by temporary pre-stocking rather than true end-user demand.
Analysts questioned if the sharp surge in A&P expenses in FMEG represents a permanent new run rate.

guidance.statement: Invest Rs 60-80 billion in capital expenditure over the next five years.
guidance.quote: committed a monumental capital expenditure of around `60 billion to `80 billion over the next five years

guidance.statement: Target an EBITDA margin of 8% to 10% for the FMEG business.
guidance.quote: targeting an EBITDA margin of 8% to 10%

guidance.statement: Maintain Wires & Cables EBITDA margins between 11% and 13%.
guidance.quote: 11-13% Wires & Cables EBITDA

guidance.statement: Increase export revenue contribution to over 10% of total revenue.
guidance.quote: aiming to increase our export revenue contribution to over 10%

guidance.statement: Increase the dividend payout ratio towards 30% by FY30.
guidance.quote: continue to increase our dividend payout ratio towards 30% by FY30.

guidance.statement: Grow core Wires & Cables business at 1.5x the market growth rate.
guidance.quote: growing our core W&C business at 1.5x the market growth rate.

guidance.statement: Grow FMEG business at 1.5x to 2x the industry rate.
guidance.quote: our goal is to grow FMEG at 1.5x to 2x the industry rate

delivered.statement: Delivered revenue of Rs 288,838 million in FY26, up 29% YoY.
Achieved profit of Rs 27,084 million in FY26.
Incurred capital expenditure of Rs 14.8 billion in FY26.
Wires & Cables segment revenue grew 33% YoY to Rs 252 billion.
FMEG segment revenue grew 25% YoY to Rs 20,693 million.
Renewable electricity contribution reached 18.4% of total electricity mix.

calls.tone: Confident, disciplined, and focused on sustainable long-term value creation and execution under Project Spring.

bull.point: Consolidated revenue grew 53% year-on-year in Q2 FY27, driven by strong domestic demand.
FMEG segment registered 124% year-on-year growth, with EBIT margins crossing double-digits for the first time at 10.1%.
Company maintains a pristine balance sheet, being practically debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02.
Working-capital days have shortened by 28 days over 3 years, dropping from 58 to 30 days.

cite.table: Working-capital days shortened by 28 days in 3 years (58 → 30)

bear.point: Volume growth has occasionally faced headwinds, with cable and wire volume growth dropping to low single digits in Q4 FY26.
Export growth has experienced headwinds and a decline, with high reliance and potential vulnerabilities exposed in markets like the Middle East.
Channel checks suggest aggressive competitor pricing pressure, with some peers pricing wires 10% to 15% lower.

watch: Export recovery and Middle East exposure
